summary: Gauzy Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that on November 4, 2026 the Nasdaq Hearings Panel granted its request to continue listing on the Nasdaq Stock Market, conditioned on demonstrating compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) by December 15, 2026. The company had appealed a September 15, 2026 Staff Determination Letter to delist its securities from the Nasdaq Global Market, triggered by failure to file its Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. No terms, pricing or advisors were disclosed. Watch the December 15 filing deadline; missing it risks suspension and delisting.
